# LeetLockin

> LeetLockin is a pattern-first coding interview preparation platform for software engineers. It teaches LeetCode-style problems through a structured curriculum, an AI Socratic tutor that gives progressive hints rather than answers, spaced repetition review, and AI-powered voice mock interviews.

## Product

- Homepage: https://leetlockin.com/
- Pricing: https://leetlockin.com/pricing
- Privacy: https://leetlockin.com/privacy
- Terms: https://leetlockin.com/terms
- Security: https://leetlockin.com/security

## What LeetLockin Is

LeetLockin is a structured curriculum, not a problem bank. It teaches the transferable patterns behind coding interview questions — Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Prefix Sum, Binary Search, Hashing, Stacks, BFS, DFS and Backtracking, Trees, Heaps, and Dynamic Programming — before presenting problems. The platform includes 200+ Python problems organized into 4 learning paths and 37 curriculum blocks, an AI tutor that gives progressive Socratic hints rather than solutions, spaced repetition flashcards generated from solved problems, and AI-powered voice mock interviews with a post-session debrief.

## Curriculum Paths

1. Python Foundations — variables, control flow, functions, lists, dictionaries, sets, comprehensions.
2. Core Data Structures — arrays, hash maps, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, graphs.
3. Pattern Library — Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Prefix Sum, Binary Search, Hashing, Stack patterns, BFS, DFS and Backtracking, Tree patterns, Heap patterns, Dynamic Programming.
4. Interview Ready — timed problem solving, communication, clean code, mock interviews.

## Pricing

- Free plan ($0): full curriculum, all 200+ problems, in-browser Python execution, progress tracking, and 5 AI tutor messages per week. No credit card required.
- Pro plan: monthly or yearly billing in USD via Stripe. Includes unlimited AI tutoring, voice mock interviews, spaced-repetition flashcards, and streak freezes. Cancel anytime.

## Target Audience

Software engineers preparing for technical coding interviews at top technology companies, including FAANG-style interview loops. Also suitable for Python beginners — Path 1 covers Python fundamentals before any algorithms.

## Differentiator

Unlike a problem bank, LeetLockin is a curriculum: problems are grouped by pattern and unlocked progressively. The AI tutor gives a broad nudge first, then a technique pointer, then concrete mechanics — it does not hand the user the answer. Hints are designed to close knowledge gaps without short-circuiting learning.
